project: Wuxia Life P72 Selected Next Route Entry Differentiation
description: Add the smallest bounded post-bridge entry differentiation for the selected next route so its identity survives the first shared destination layer, without expanding into deeper cost, shape, or payoff work.

userStories.title: Audit post-bridge entry sharedness
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of what the selected route currently shares at post-bridge entry so P72 targets the real flattening point.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize the currently shared gates, markers, and expression at the post-bridge entry layer
Separate healthy reuse from flattening that weakens player-perceived route identity
Save docs/test-reports/p72-selected-route-entry-sharedness-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Sharedness audit complete — 6 flattening points identified, 4 addressable in P72 bounded scope

userStories.title: Lock P72 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P72 stays an entry-differentiation stage and does not sprawl into deeper route densification.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P72 to early post-bridge and entry-adjacent differentiation only
Define allowed layers: light configuration, expression, proof, and narrow tests
List forbidden expansions: pressure or payoff waves, new systems, and full route expansion
Save docs/test-reports/p72-selected-route-entry-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope contract locked — 4 allowed layers, 4 forbidden expansion categories, boundary guards defined

userStories.title: Define entry differentiation contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit entry contract so the selected route's bridge identity survives contact with the shared destination path.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the core identity signals that must be preserved at entry for the selected route
State which differences belong in expression and which belong in light markers
Keep the shared destination skeleton intact
Record the contract in the PRD or an appendix artifact
userStories.notes: Entry differentiation contract defined — 4 core identity signals, 3 expression surfaces + light markers, tavern-born flavor preserved, shared skeleton intact

userStories.title: Wire entry-level differentiation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the selected route's post-bridge entry to expose bounded differentiation through existing carriers rather than a new framework.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement the entry differentiation only through existing carriers, markers, or gate-adjacent wiring
Do not introduce a new route framework
Existing P71 bridge evidence does not regress
The shared destination chain remains stably triggerable
userStories.notes: Entry-level wiring complete — detectSampleLine recognizes renown, renownCurrentGoal + deriveSampleLineCostLabel + renownAge40Identity added via existing carriers; no new framework; P71 tests still pass

userStories.title: Add player-facing entry expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the selected route to read differently immediately after crossing the bridge so the new path keeps its identity at the first shared layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least three entry-specific readable signals across existing expression surfaces
Make the post-bridge entry identity distinguishable from the generic path
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests

userStories.title: Add targeted entry proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the selected route remains distinguishable at entry after crossing into the shared destination path.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce one comparison-style targeted proof artifact
Show entry markers or expression differences for the selected route versus the generic path
Do not require full lifetime exhaust
Ensure the proof directly supports whether deeper differentiation is worth opening

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the new entry differentiation so later edits do not flatten the route back into a generic shared entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover entry markers, player-facing expression, and comparison-level assertions with narrow checks
Reuse existing harnesses
Do not rewrite the full test suite
Relevant commands pass

userStories.title: Produce P72 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly what entry differentiation now exists and whether deeper success-cost or success-shape work is justified later.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p72-selected-next-route-entry-closure-report.md
Summarize the sharedness audit, contract, wiring, expression, proof, and tests
State whether deeper differentiation is worth opening later
List larger route-expansion items that remain deferred
